scope: Blinded partial-cohort export, individual original review freeze, exact public-content per-reviewer remapping, and complete review assembly; not model-answer quality review
review_kind: independent assistant source and synthetic artifact review

validation.inputs: Synthetic temporary fixtures only, including fake sealed157-attempt prefix; no collected observations read

findings: Packet builder exactly matches analyzer grouping, seeded opaque identities, common fields and second-reviewer shuffle through AST-extracted independent parity test.
All authorized packets receive the same full authoritative currently eligible23-record truth context; denied packets receive none; expired, superseded and wrong-profile records are excluded.
Undelivered raw text never appears as a delivered answer; model, condition, timing, repetition and observation maps are excluded from public packets.
Individual original packet, instruction and review bytes are copied exactly and sealed before matching or comparison.
Remapping uses exact canonical public content excluding only review_id, and permits only explicit same-reviewer identity/aliases and identical instruction bytes.
Conflicting label/five-flag vectors or any changed public content require a fresh missing-packet judgment; no heuristic or semantic labels are generated.

Assembly independently recomputes content joins, score agreement, chosen original rationale, missing groups and mapping from every archived sealed original; a tampered-and-resealed reused sheet is rejected.
Coverage requires every target packet group exactly once, and all remap/original/missing artifacts and source/input hashes remain sealed.
Final full analyzer integrity and864-attempt coverage verification remain required; partial export is explicitly scoped as a reviewed cohort.
use_constraints: Export only a sealed cumulative run during a no-model interval; this operational requirement is documented and is not an OS interlock.
Give each reviewer only their assigned public packet and unchanged instructions; keep mappings, provenance and other reviewer sheets inaccessible in review context.
Reviewer identity aliases are caller attestations, not proof of independent cognition; fresh independent review contexts and third-context adjudication remain required.
